verdict.rationale: jo is a personal consumer agent tied to a user's own Mac/cloud machine, phone/email identity, and chat surfaces (Telegram, WhatsApp, macOS app) — it is designed as an always-on personal assistant, not a CLI/tool meant to be invoked headlessly inside a CI pipeline. This is a category mismatch rather than a missing feature: the OpenAPI spec exposes internal app/bridge endpoints with no documented developer program, public API keys, or CI-oriented invocation model.
